annotations.title: What LLPRO Certified means, how a product is assessed, and the public signed register. Nothing is certified yet

description: LLPRO Certified public register lookup. Send a subject id (a product, service or agent id, lowercase letters, digits, . _ : -, up to 96 characters) to get issued, not_found, revoked or expired for it; send nothing to get the whole register (counts, head hash, criteria hash and the events, up to 200). Every answer is signed by LLPRO Certified (Ed25519 over canonical JSON); check it offline with the verifier at https://llpro.ai/certified-verify. At launch the register holds 0 issued: nothing is certified until a real assessment passes all written criteria. It does not show that a product is safe, legal or fit for any purpose, and not_found does not mean a product failed an assessment. Free. No network, no model, nothing about you is stored on disk.
